title: NetworkModGrantChange
description: network.mod-grant-change@1 (OpenVibe.Network; roadmap WS-M task 3, ADR-013): approve or revoke one requested capability of a mod principal, POST /internal/mods/{mod_id}/grants (the owning runtime, mods.grant.manage) or POST /api/admin/mods/{mod_id}/grants (staff.games.manage, with a reason).
